The throttle command slews at most 300 %/s: SET_OUT_RAMP, 5 to 300 %/s (shared/settings/settings.c:61-63), published as the panel's throttle ramp (firmware/panel/main/main.c:94-104). On the onboard path's 150 A continuous (F2) that is at most 450 A/s, taken linearly in throttle. The Internal R default, 18 mΩ for the whole pack (settings.c:44-46), over the default 6 cells (settings.c:38-40) is 3 mΩ a cell, which moves 1 mV (V182) for 0.333 A; 450 A/s covers 0.333 A in 741 µs. The 16-cell pack of F15 at 18 mΩ (1.125 mΩ a cell) on the external path's 300 A (900 A/s, V35 found in T2) gives 988 µs; the smaller figure holds. No source pairs a 6-cell pack with 300 A; that case gives 370 µs and is reported

report.value: no minimum cell count; unused C inputs shorted to the highest connected cell or left open; V+ 16 to 90 V for TME, from the stack or an isolated supply; TME also needs V+ to C18 at least -0.3 V, C7 at least 1 V and C13 at least 2.5 V. A pack under 16 V needs an auxiliary V+ supply
report.source: LTC6813-1 datasheet Rev. B, 'Using the LTC6813-1 with Fewer than 18 Cells' and electrical characteristics, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ltc6813-1.pdf read 2026-09-28T15:11:05Z

packs under 16 V at the lead need at least 16 V on V+, referenced to the pack's negative and diode-ORed with the stack top (V+ at least C18 - 0.3 V): 1 to 3 cells at 4.2 V, 1 to 5 cells at the 2.8 V floor of V184. Its current is the V+ current: 0.95 mA typical, 1.4 mA maximum in MEASURE (ADBMS1818)
report.source: ADBMS1818 datasheet Rev. B Table 3, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/adbms1818.pdf read 2026-09-28T15:11:05Z; V184

report.value: VREG 15 mA typical, 16.5 mA maximum in MEASURE, 3.1 µA typical in SLEEP; isoSPI adds 1.0 to 10.5 mA on VREG by bias and state; V+ 0.95 mA typical, 1.4 mA maximum in MEASURE, 6.1 µA typical, 18 µA maximum in SLEEP. VREG is made from V+ through an NPN on DRIVE or supplied at 4.5 to 5.5 V; the current comes from the pack or the auxiliary supply, not the IO board's 3.3 V rail, unless VREG is fed from the board
report.source: ADBMS1818 datasheet Rev. B Table 3, read 2026-09-28T15:11:05Z

report.value: 4-wire SPI referenced to the pack's negative (ISOMD at V-), or 2-wire isoSPI (transformer-coupled), which needs an isoSPI transceiver such as the LTC6820 on the RP2354B side; either takes 1 SPI controller and 4 GPIO. No I²C address, no RP2354B ADC input. With the ground offset of V189 not found, isoSPI is the interface that does not depend on it
report.source: ADBMS1818 datasheet Rev. B Table 14 and Table 15, read 2026-09-28T15:11:05Z; LTC6820 rows C514444 (2912) and C581009 (2544) in the jlcparts copy of 2026-09-14, not counted at JLCPCB
